name: quotum-hub
description: The Quotum hub: stores what agents measure and serves the dashboard of coding-agent subscription limits (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity).
author: Sergey Padurets

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui-test.json
